action_ledger.purpose: localize the power-strip outlets before any own arm motion
action_ledger.method: First Astra call: the locate_outlets helper (registry locate_mm, target outlets). The harness moved the observer arm to one wrist view above the strip and back (harness stage moves, not Astra decisions) and returned outlets_xyz and strip_yaw.
action_ledger.observed_effect: Phase completed; the episode reached native success at step 303.
action_ledger.reusable_lesson: Call locate_mm(outlets) once at the start while both arms are still away from the strip; it returns outlets_xyz and strip_yaw for later target arithmetic at a cost of locate_step_cost steps. In each of the four plug successes the insertion targets were geometrically consistent with these outlets (ee-uptake check).

action_ledger.method: Bounded EEF increments (each within the per_action_translation_limit and per_action_rotation_limit of the CURRENT EEF) moving above the charger while rotating the gripper to point down with the jaws across the charger body (reason texts: "approach from above", "align parallel jaws with charger sidewalls"), then lowering to grasp_close_eef_z.
action_ledger.observed_effect: Phase completed; the episode reached native success at step 303.
action_ledger.reusable_lesson: Approach the charger from above and finish the downward wrist rotation before lowering; lower to grasp_close_eef_z only after the jaws are across the charger sidewalls. Plan every increment from the current EEF: targets beyond per_action_translation_limit or per_action_rotation_limit are rejected before execution and cost a turn.

general_facts: Each accepted decision executes a short fixed number of native control steps; one bounded EEF target per decision.
Targets are rejected before execution if they exceed per_action_translation_limit or per_action_rotation_limit relative to the CURRENT EEF, or reuse a stale request_id (rejections this episode: 1).
Astra commanded only the left arm (grasp, transport, insertion); the right arm stayed at its home pose apart from harness locate observation moves when it was the observer arm.
The charger object position used in the target arithmetic is link6 + R(q) * (tcp_offset_link6_x + charger_offset_in_tcp).
inhand_pose notes a known failure mode: about one frame in eight can be wrong by a half turn of the charger without the report noticing.
An automatic hold check after the lift reported stable (no turning or sliding).

summary: Native success at step 303 (limit 400) in batch v18a TREAT (layout 0). Astra called locate_outlets first, grasped the charger top-down with the left arm, turned the pins down during transport, hovered above outlet index 0 computed from the located outlets and the in-hand estimate, inserted with pure vertical decrements and released.
